series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Through 2027, fully virtual workspaces will account for 30% of the investment growth by enterprises in metaverse technologies and will “reimagine” the office experience.
entries.subject: Virtual workspaces in the metaverse
entries.metric: share of enterprise metaverse investment growth from fully virtual workspaces

entries.quote: By 2025, without sustainable artificial intelligence (AI) practices, AI will consume more energy than the human workforce, significantly offsetting carbon zero gains.
entries.subject: AI energy consumption
entries.note: Comparative claim: AI will consume more energy than the human workforce, without sustainable AI practices.

entries.quote: By 2026, citizen-led denial of service (cDOS) attacks, using virtual assistants to shut down operations, will become the fastest growing form of protest.
entries.subject: Citizen-led denial of service protest

entries.quote: Through 2025, powerhouse cloud ecosystems will consolidate the vendor landscape by 30% leaving customers with fewer choices and less control of their software destiny.
entries.subject: Cloud ecosystem vendor consolidation

entries.quote: Through 2024, jointly owned sovereignty partnerships sanctioned by regulators will increase stakeholder trust in global cloud brands and facilitate continued IT globalization.
entries.subject: Sovereign cloud partnerships

entries.quote: By 2025, “labor volatility” will cause 40% of organizations to report a material business loss, forcing a shift in talent strategy from acquisition to resilience.
entries.subject: Labor volatility
entries.metric: share of organizations reporting a material business loss from labor volatility

entries.quote: By 2025, shareholder acceptance of moonshot speculative investments will double, making them a viable alternative to traditional R&D spend to accelerate growth.
entries.subject: Moonshot investments
entries.metric: change in shareholder acceptance of moonshot investments

entries.quote: By 2027, social media platform models will shift from “customer as product” to “platform as customer” of decentralized identity, sold through data markets.
entries.subject: Decentralized identity and social media

entries.quote: By 2025, organizations that remediate documented gender pay gaps will decrease women's attrition by 30%, reducing pressure on talent shortages.
entries.subject: Gender pay gap remediation
entries.metric: decrease in women's attrition at organizations that remediate pay gaps

entries.quote: Through 2025, employee value metrics like well-being, burnout, and brand satisfaction will override return on investment (ROI) evaluations in 30% of successful growth investment decisions.
entries.subject: Employee value metrics in investment decisions
entries.metric: share of successful growth investment decisions where employee value metrics override ROI

notes: Edition covers '2023 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions').
